title: Codeberg: ToU extension to prohibit LLM-extrusions
summary: Codeberg, a Git hosting platform for open source projects, is proposing to extend their Terms of Use to explicitly prohibit 'LLM-extrusions' - preventing AI companies from scraping their code repositories to train language models without consent. This policy update is a response to growing concerns about open source code being used to train AI systems without proper licensing or attribution.
problem_solved: Addresses the unauthorized use of open source code repositories for training large language models without maintainer consent or proper licensing.
why_valuable: This policy protects open source maintainers' intellectual property rights and ensures their voluntary contributions aren't exploited by AI companies for commercial purposes without permission.
